div.div: Without an origin shield, a cold cache in 200 PoPs is 200 requests to your origin for the same file. With it — plus request coalescing — the origin sees one.

div.div: The two sentences that score: "static assets never reach a pod, they are immutable at the edge", and "I invalidate by changing the URL, not by purging" — because a global purge is both slow to propagate and a thundering herd against the origin.
